name: seerrcompanion
description: Seerr companion: trims multi-season requests to the first season and marks unwatched series for deletion, with a web UI to approve or keep.

paths.name: Config
paths.description: Holds the state database and web UI secret.

variables.name: WEBUI_USERNAME
variables.description: Web UI login username; the UI is off unless this and the password are set.

variables.name: DRY_RUN
variables.description: true = log only, change and delete nothing; set false to go live.

variables.name: TAUTULLI_URL
variables.description: Tautulli base URL for watch state; blank uses Seerr's own watch data.

variables.name: APPRISE_URLS
variables.description: Comma-separated Apprise notification URLs; blank logs only.

variables.name: WEBUI_URL
variables.description: Public URL of this web UI, added to notifications as a review link.

variables.name: SEERR_PUBLIC_URL
variables.description: Seerr URL for title links in the UI, if SEERR_URL is internal.

variables.name: TRIM_SEASONS
variables.description: Trim pending multi-season TV requests to the first season.

variables.name: APPROVE_AFTER_TRIM
variables.description: Approve a request after trimming it.

variables.name: FLAG_UNWATCHED
variables.description: Mark a user's unwatched series for deletion when they request another title.

variables.name: PURGE_AFTER_DAYS
variables.description: Auto-delete flagged titles after this many days; blank never auto-deletes.

variables.name: IGNORE_USER_IDS
variables.description: Comma-separated Seerr user IDs to skip.
